integrity: The theorem is derived from published homotopy machinery plus a new girth-based walk classification; independent validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The Hom splitting is nonequivariant; only component permutations carry the proved dihedral structure. Sharp girth condition, even source lengths. Relies on published square-free Hom-complex theorem. Finite verifications are corroborative, not exhaustive for the infinite family.
title: Rigidity and dihedral cycle detection in high-girth graph Hom complexes
